Why.label: Why Pyground
Why.body: Every lesson has a short explanation, examples you can run, and a small quiz. Learn by doing, a little at a time.

features.title: Runs in your browser
features.body: Python runs right on the lesson page. Nothing to install to get started.

features.title: Indonesian and English
features.body: Familiar examples: the warung, a kos room, ojek fares, report-card grades.

features.title: A quiz in every lesson
features.body: Three quick questions to make sure you've got it before moving on.

features.title: Progress and streaks
features.body: Your progress is saved, and a daily streak helps you keep a routine.

Overview.label: Your learning space
Overview.title: All your progress, in one place

Stages.label: Four stages
Stages.title: From your first print to building for the web
Stages.body: Lessons build on each other, so you always know what comes next.

items.title: Foundations
items.summary: Variables, input, strings, conditionals, and a cashier project.

items.title: Beginner Core
items.summary: Loops, lists, dictionaries, functions, and debugging.

items.title: Intermediate
items.summary: Files, OOP, decorators, generators, type hints, and pytest.

items.title: Web with Flask

Showcase.label: Learn by building
Showcase.statement: Every stage ends with a real project: a corner-shop cashier, a student grade book, and an expense tracker that saves data to a file and is tested with pytest.

items.q: I've never coded before. Can I join?
items.a: Yes. Stage 1 starts from "what is a program" and uses everyday examples. You don't need a maths or IT background.

items.q: Do I need to install Python?
items.a: No. Python runs right in your browser. You only install Python in Stage 3, when you learn pip and virtual environments, and there's a guide for it.

items.q: Can I learn on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Every page is designed for phone screens. For longer code, a laptop is still more comfortable.
No. Access lasts 30 days from payment. We email you 3 days before and on the day it ends. If you extend early, 30 days are added to the access you have left.

items.q: What happens to my progress when access ends?
items.a: Your progress stays saved. Stage 1 stays open, and the other lessons unlock again as soon as you extend.
Yes. Every lesson is available in Indonesian and English, and you can switch language at any time.
